ratings_guide.title: 📊 RATINGS GUIDE
ratings_guide.con: CON — Contact: Determines the probability of making contact. High CON players have higher chances of singles and hits overall.
ratings_guide.pwr: PWR — Power: Probability of extra-base hits (doubles, triples, home runs). Also increases damage to opponent pitcher on deep hits.
ratings_guide.eye: EYE — Vision/Eye: Probability of getting walks (BB). Key for advancing runners and wearing down the rival pitcher.
ratings_guide.k_avd: K/AVD — Strikeout Avoidance: Shrinks the strikeout (SO) zone on the dice roll. Essential for preventing direct HP damage caused by strikeouts.
ratings_guide.spd: SPD — Speed: Triggers base stealing attempts on singles (+20% pitcher damage debuff). Also improves chance of converting hits to extra bases.
ratings_guide.def: DEF — Defense: Contributes to team Shield. Higher average DEF gives you more shield to absorb OUTs before losing HP.
ratings_guide.captain: 👑 CAPTAIN: +5 to all ratings for all teammates while on the active roster.
ratings_guide.clutch: ⚡ CLUTCH PLAYER: +2% single and double chance, +4% HR chance with runners in scoring position or during the last inning.

combat_info.title: ⚙️ DAMAGE DATA & VALUES
combat_info.out: 🤚 OUT (Flyout/Groundout): Subtracts -16 HP from Shield (upon breaking, subtracts from team HP).
combat_info.so:
💨 STRIKEOUT (SO): Subtracts -16 HP directly from HP (ignores shield).
🔥 Streak: 1st (-16) • 2nd (-22) • 3rd+ (-28 HP)
combat_info.rbi_bonus: 🏆 RBI Bonus: Each RBI adds +10 extra HP damage to pitcher.
combat_info.defense:
🛡️ DEFENSIVE DUEL (Bottom of Inning):
Success (20% + 0.70×DEF): +30 HP & +15 Shield • Error: -15 Damage.
combat_info.steal:
🏃 BASE STEALING (SPD ≥ 40):
On 1B or BB with 2B open: attempts to steal (15% + 0.70×SPD). Grants +20% damage to pitcher for 2 impacts.
combat_info.upgrade:
⚡ HIT UPGRADES:
With SPD ≥ 70 (Grades B+ to S), runners have 15% to 50% chance to stretch hits into extra bases (1B→2B→3B).
combat_info.shield_max: 🛡️ Max shield: 50 (50% of average DEF of your 8 starters).
